title: Vietnamese-Style Grilled Pork Chops with Chestnut Rice
description: A flavorful and healthy dish that combines the savory flavors of Vietnam with the earthy taste of chestnuts. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season pork chops with salt, pepper, and vietnamese chili flakes.
Grill pork chops for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together light soy sauce and kissed sesame oil.
Brush the sauce onto the grilled pork chops during the last minute of cooking.
Serve pork chops with chestnut rice, green onions, and crushed cha gio.
Garnish with additional green onions and cha gio if desired.
Cook chestnut rice according to package instructions.
Heat a small amount of kissed sesame oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add crushed cha gio and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in cooked chestnut rice and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
